# Annual paid leave in Japan

Employees at the Tokyo and Osaka offices receive 10 days of paid annual leave once they have worked for six months, rising by one or two days each year up to a maximum of 20 days. Unused days carry over for one year and then expire. By law, everyone entitled to 10 or more days must take at least 5 of them within the year, and HR will assign dates if you fall short. Half-day leave can be used up to 10 times a year. Apply in the attendance system at least one week in advance.

---
# Partner API rate limits

The Hikari partner REST API allows 600 requests per minute per API key and a burst of 50 requests per second. When the limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait. Clients should implement exponential backoff. Enterprise partners can request a higher quota through their account manager. Webhook deliveries do not count toward the limit.

---
# API versioning and deprecation

The partner API is versioned in the URL path, for example /v2/orders. A new major version is released only for breaking changes, and each major version remains supported for at least 18 months after its successor goes live. Deprecated versions return a Sunset header with the shutdown date, and partners receive email reminders 6 months and 1 month beforehand. Additive changes, such as new optional fields, are shipped to the current version without notice, so clients must ignore unknown fields. Version 1 will be switched off on 31 March 2027.

# Bulk orders for businesses

Companies purchasing 20 units or more of the same model qualify for bulk pricing with discounts from 8% to 15%. Bulk orders include a dedicated account manager, extended 36-month warranty and installation scheduling across multiple sites. Payment terms of net 30 days are available after a credit check. Quotes are valid for 14 days.

# Changing the phone number on your account

To change the phone number linked to your Hikari Home account, go to Profile > Account details > Phone number. We send a one-time code to both the old and the new number, and you enter both to confirm. If you no longer have access to the old number, visit any showroom with your ID card or upload a photo of your ID in the app, and support will verify you within 2 working days. For security, the number can be changed only once every 30 days, and the new number must not already be registered to another account.

---
# Cash on delivery in Vietnam

Cash on delivery (COD) is available for orders in Vietnam of up to 20 million VND. Please prepare the exact amount, as couriers may not carry change for large notes; you can also pay the courier by scanning a VietQR code. Orders above 20 million VND and pre-orders require online payment in advance. You may open the box and check the product's appearance before paying, but electrical appliances cannot be tested on the doorstep. Accounts that refuse COD parcels three times lose access to cash on delivery.

title: Rescheduling a delivery in Vietnam
description: If you will not be at home, you can reschedule a delivery in Vietnam from the order page in the app until 6 pm the day before.

---
# Rescheduling a delivery in Vietnam

If you will not be at home, you can reschedule a delivery in Vietnam from the order page in the app until 6 pm the day before. The courier makes up to three delivery attempts and phones you before each one. After three failed attempts the parcel goes back to our warehouse and the order is cancelled; prepaid orders are refunded minus the outbound shipping fee. You can also ask the courier to leave the package with your building security, provided you confirm this in writing by SMS.

# Smart appliance shows Offline in the app

If an appliance that was set up earlier now appears as Offline in the Hikari app, first check that your router is working and the appliance is within range; thick concrete walls can block the signal. Power-cycle the appliance by unplugging it for 30 seconds. Many offline cases are caused by routers that merge the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands under one network name, so turn off band steering or create a separate 2.4 GHz network. If the status is still Offline after 10 minutes, remove the device and add it again.

description: Hikari refrigerators show a code on the door display when something is wrong.
lang: en
---
# Refrigerator error codes

Hikari refrigerators show a code on the door display when something is wrong. E1 means the freezer sensor has failed; food will stay cold for a while, but you should book a repair. E2 is a defrost heater fault, often noticed as ice building up on the back wall. E3 means a door has been left open for more than 3 minutes. E4 indicates that the ice maker water tank is empty or not seated properly. E6 is a compressor start failure: unplug for 10 minutes, then plug back in. Hold the Lock button for 3 seconds to clear the display.

# Travel expense reimbursement

Employees traveling for work can claim reimbursement for transport, hotel and meals. Hotel costs are capped at 1.5 million VND per night domestically and 150 USD per night abroad. Submit claims with original receipts in the expense system within 15 days after returning. Alcohol and personal entertainment are not reimbursable. Approved claims are paid with the next monthly salary.

---
# International shipping

We ship to Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand and the United States. International orders are dispatched within 2 business days and usually arrive in 7 to 14 days. Import duties and taxes are calculated at checkout and paid by the recipient. Large appliances such as refrigerators cannot be shipped overseas because of voltage and plug differences. Every international parcel includes a tracking number from our courier partner.

# Correcting a VAT e-invoice

If your Vietnamese VAT e-invoice contains a mistake such as a wrong tax code, company name or address, contact us within 5 days of receiving it. When only the buyer's name or address is wrong, we issue an adjustment invoice; if the tax code, amount or tax rate is wrong, the original is cancelled and a replacement invoice is issued. Both parties must sign the correction record electronically before the new invoice is sent. Invoices already declared in a previous tax period can only be adjusted, not replaced.

---
# New employee onboarding

On the first day, new hires receive a laptop, an access badge and accounts for email, chat and the HR system. During the first week they complete mandatory training on information security and the code of conduct. Each newcomer is paired with a buddy from another team for the first month. Managers hold a 30-day check-in meeting to review goals and answer questions.

# Birthday rewards for Hikari Club members

During your birthday month, Hikari Club members in Vietnam receive a voucher in the app: 100,000 VND for Silver, 300,000 VND for Gold and 500,000 VND for Diamond members. The voucher can be used on any order over 1 million VND and expires at the end of that month. You also earn double points on every purchase during your birthday month. Make sure your date of birth is filled in your profile at least 30 days beforehand; the date cannot be changed once saved.

---
# Earning points by writing product reviews

Hikari Club members earn 20 points for each product review posted in the app after a verified purchase, and 50 points if the review includes at least two photos or a short video. Reviews must be at least 50 characters long and are checked by our team within 3 working days before the points are credited. Only one review per product per order counts. Copied, offensive or off-topic reviews are rejected and earn nothing. Points from reviews follow the same expiry rules as points earned from purchases.

---
# Cancelling a pre-order

New models can be pre-ordered with a 10% deposit before their launch date. You may cancel a pre-order and get the full deposit back at any time until we send the 'ready to ship' notification. After that, cancelling means the deposit is forfeited, unless the launch was delayed by more than 30 days from the date shown when you ordered. Pre-order prices are locked in, and if the official price drops at launch, we refund the difference automatically. Pre-orders cannot be combined with trade-in offers.

lang: en

# Personal data deletion requests

Customers can ask us to delete their personal data at any time by sending a request from the app settings or emailing privacy@hikari.example. We verify identity and complete the deletion within 30 days. Order and invoice records required by tax law are kept for the legal retention period but are no longer used for marketing. Deleting data also closes the customer's account and forfeits remaining loyalty points.

lang: en
---
# Replacing the air purifier filter

The HEPA filter in Hikari air purifiers should be replaced every 12 months, or sooner if you live near a busy road. The activated carbon pre-filter can be vacuumed monthly and should be replaced every 6 months. When the filter indicator turns red, open the rear cover, pull the old filter out by its tab and insert the new one with the printed arrow facing the fan. Then hold the Filter Reset button for 5 seconds until the light goes off. Rinsing a HEPA filter with water destroys it, so never wash it.

---
# Refund processing timeline

Once a returned item passes inspection at our warehouse, the refund is issued to the original payment method. Credit card refunds appear on the statement within 5 to 10 business days depending on the issuing bank. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer within 3 business days after the customer submits account details. Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the item was defective or we sent the wrong product.

lang: en
---
# Remote work policy

Employees may work from home up to three days per week after completing their probation period. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 local time, during which staff must be reachable on chat. Working from abroad for more than 14 consecutive days requires written approval from HR because of tax and insurance rules. The company provides a one-time home office allowance of 5 million VND for equipment.

---
# Returns on display and open-box items

Showroom display units and open-box products are sold at up to 40% off and carry an orange 'Trưng bày' sticker. These items cannot be returned simply because you changed your mind. If a hidden defect appears, you may exchange the item within 7 days of purchase as long as the same model is still in stock; otherwise we repair it under warranty. Display units come with a reduced 12-month warranty regardless of product category. Please inspect the item with our staff before paying, because cosmetic scratches are not grounds for an exchange.

# Returns for orders placed on Shopee, Lazada and Tiki

If you bought a Hikari product from our official store on Shopee, Lazada or Tiki, the return must be requested through that marketplace, not through the Hikari app or a showroom. Each platform applies its own return window, usually 7 days from delivery, and the refund is paid by the platform to your marketplace wallet or original payment method. Our showroom staff cannot accept these items or issue refunds for them. Warranty service, however, is exactly the same as for products bought directly: just bring the serial number to any service center.

---
# Rice cooker error codes

Hikari rice cookers display error codes on the front panel. E1 means the temperature sensor is disconnected; unplug the cooker and contact service. E2 indicates overheating, usually because the inner pot is empty or not seated correctly. E3 means the lid is not fully closed. E4 is a power voltage problem. If an error persists after restarting, stop using the appliance and request a repair.

lang: en

# Caring for the rice cooker inner pot

To make the non-stick coating of your Hikari rice cooker's inner pot last, use only the plastic rice paddle and measuring cup supplied. Wash the pot with a soft sponge and mild detergent after each use; do not rinse rice in it with a metal whisk, and never put the pot in a dishwasher. Wipe the inner lid and steam vent every week, because starch build-up can make the cooker boil over. Replacement inner pots can be ordered from our service centers for about 900,000 VND.

# Security incident response playbook

If you suspect a security incident such as a leaked password, phishing email or unauthorized access, report it immediately in the #security-incident channel and page the on-call engineer. Do not delete evidence or reboot affected machines. The incident commander classifies severity from SEV1 to SEV4 within 30 minutes. For SEV1 and SEV2, affected credentials are rotated right away and customers are notified within 72 hours if personal data was exposed.

# Repair service center opening hours

Our repair service centers in Hanoi (Cau Giay), Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City (Tan Binh) are open from 8:00 to 17:30, Monday to Saturday, and closed on Sundays and public holidays. The centers handle walk-in repairs for small appliances such as rice cookers, fans and air purifiers; for large appliances, please book a home visit in the app instead. Walk-in customers are served in order of arrival, and diagnosis is free even if you decide not to go ahead with the repair. Items not collected within 90 days after repair are disposed of.

lang: en
---
# Delivery and installation of large appliances

Refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners are delivered in Vietnam by our own two-person installation crews rather than a parcel courier. The crew calls the day before to confirm a two-hour time slot. Standard installation is free, but carrying an item up stairs above the third floor in a building without a lift costs 50,000 VND per floor. For air conditioners, the first 3 metres of copper pipe are included; extra pipe and wall brackets are charged according to the price list. Please make sure doorways are at least 70 cm wide.

---
type: Support Article
title: Sick leave for Vietnam offices
description: Staff in our Vietnam offices who are unwell should inform their manager before 9:00 on the day of absence.
lang: en
---
# Sick leave for Vietnam offices

Staff in our Vietnam offices who are unwell should inform their manager before 9:00 on the day of absence. Up to two days of sick leave per month can be taken without a medical certificate and are fully paid by the company. Longer absences require a doctor's note or hospital discharge paper, uploaded to the HR system within 5 days of returning; these days are then paid through social insurance at 75% of the insured salary. Sick days never reduce your annual leave balance.

---
type: Support Article
title: Signing in with Google, Apple or Zalo
description: You can sign in to the Hikari Home app with a Google, Apple or Zalo account instead of a password.
lang: en
---
# Signing in with Google, Apple or Zalo

You can sign in to the Hikari Home app with a Google, Apple or Zalo account instead of a password. If you already have an account registered with your phone number, link the social login under Settings > Linked accounts so that your orders and points stay in one place; signing in with a new social account creates a separate, empty profile, and accounts cannot be merged later. To unlink a provider, you must first set a password so you do not lose access. LINE login is available only in the Japan app.

---
type: Support Article
title: Typhoon and flood days
description: When a typhoon or severe flooding is forecast in Vietnam, HR announces a decision by 18:00 the day before.
lang: en
---
# Typhoon and flood days

When a typhoon or severe flooding is forecast in Vietnam, HR announces a decision by 18:00 the day before. Office staff switch to working from home, and showrooms in the affected cities may close early or stay closed; showroom staff receive full pay for closed days. Never travel to work through flooded streets. Customer deliveries in the affected area are postponed automatically, and customers are notified by SMS. After the storm, managers confirm by message that every team member is safe before business resumes.

title: Hikari Care+ extended warranty
description: Hikari Care+ lets you extend the standard manufacturer warranty by one or two extra years on any large appliance priced above 5 million VND.
lang: en
---
# Hikari Care+ extended warranty

Hikari Care+ lets you extend the standard manufacturer warranty by one or two extra years on any large appliance priced above 5 million VND. The plan must be bought within 30 days of delivery and costs 5% of the product price per extra year. It covers the same parts as the original warranty, plus one free maintenance visit every year. Care+ is tied to the product serial number, so it transfers automatically if you sell or give the appliance away. Plans are sold in Vietnam only and cannot be refunded after the first 15 days.

---
type: Support Article
title: Refrigerator warranty
description: Every Hikari refrigerator comes with a 24-month warranty covering parts and labour, and the inverter compressor is covered for 10 years.
lang: en
---
# Refrigerator warranty

Every Hikari refrigerator comes with a 24-month warranty covering parts and labour, and the inverter compressor is covered for 10 years. Because refrigerators are too heavy to carry in, a technician repairs the unit at your home free of charge within the warranty period. Door gaskets, shelves and light bulbs are treated as consumables and are covered for 6 months only. If the fridge stops cooling and cannot be fixed within 72 hours, we reimburse up to 500,000 VND for spoiled food when you show a purchase receipt.

---
type: Support Article
title: Verifying webhook signatures
description: Every webhook we send includes an X-Hikari-Signature header so you can confirm the request really came from us.
lang: en
---
# Verifying webhook signatures

Every webhook we send includes an X-Hikari-Signature header so you can confirm the request really came from us. The value is an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the raw request body, computed with your webhook signing secret and encoded in hex. Compute the same hash on your side and compare the two with a constant-time function. The X-Hikari-Timestamp header lets you reject requests older than 5 minutes to prevent replay attacks. Signing secrets are separate from API keys and can be rotated in the partner portal; the old secret stays valid for 24 hours.

# 二段階認証の設定

アカウントを安全に保つため、二段階認証の設定をおすすめします。アプリの「設定」から「セキュリティ」を開き、「二段階認証」をオンにしてください。Google Authenticatorなどの認証アプリでQRコードを読み取り、表示された6桁のコードを入力すると設定完了です。設定時に表示される10個のバックアップコードは、スマホを紛失した際に必要になりますので、必ず安全な場所に保管してください。

---
# エアコンフィルターの交換

ヒカリのエアコンには静電フィルターと脱臭フィルターが付いています。静電フィルターは2年に1回、脱臭フィルターは1年に1回の交換をおすすめします。交換用フィルターは公式オンラインストアで購入できます。前面パネルを開けて古いフィルターを引き抜き、新しいフィルターを差し込むだけで、工具は必要ありません。交換後はリモコンのフィルターリセットボタンを3秒押してください。

# パートナーAPIの認証方式

パートナーAPIへのアクセスには、OAuth 2.0のクライアントクレデンシャル方式を使用します。管理画面で発行したクライアントIDとシークレットを /oauth/token に送信すると、アクセストークンが返されます。トークンの有効期限は1時間で、リフレッシュトークンは発行されませんので、期限切れ後は再度取得してください。各リクエストの Authorization ヘッダーに Bearer トークンを付与します。シークレットは90日ごとのローテーションを推奨しています。

# サンドボックス環境の利用

本番環境に接続する前に、サンドボックス環境 sandbox.api.hikari.example で動作確認を行ってください。サンドボックス用のAPIキーは管理画面から即時に発行できます。レート制限は本番より低く、1分あたり60リクエストまでです。作成した注文データが実際に出荷されることはなく、毎週日曜日の深夜にすべてリセットされます。決済のテストには、ドキュメントに記載されたテスト用カード番号をご利用ください。

# 法人向けまとめ買い（日本）

日本国内の法人のお客様で、同一機種を10台以上ご購入の場合は、法人特別価格でお見積もりいたします。ホテルやオフィス、賃貸物件への一括導入に多くご利用いただいています。お見積もりの有効期限は発行日から30日です。設置工事の日程調整や、既存機器の撤去・リサイクルもまとめて承ります。お見積もりのご依頼は法人専用フォームからお願いします。保証期間は個人向けと同じです。

# ご注文のキャンセル

ご注文のキャンセルは、商品の発送前であればマイページの注文履歴から無料で行えます。発送後のキャンセルはできないため、商品到着後に返品手続きをしてください。取り寄せ商品や名入れ商品はご注文確定後のキャンセルをお受けできません。クレジットカードでお支払いの場合、キャンセル後に売上が取り消されます。

# 通勤手当の支給

通勤手当は、自宅から勤務先までの最も経済的な経路の定期代を、1か月あたり5万円を上限に支給します。マイカー通勤の場合は片道の距離に応じた定額を支給し、駐車場代は自己負担となります。引っ越しや経路の変更があった場合は、1週間以内に人事システムで申請してください。テレワークが月の半分以上になる場合は、定期代ではなく出社日数分の実費精算に切り替わります。

# 法人のお客様向け請求書払い

日本国内の法人のお客様は、請求書払い（掛け払い）をご利用いただけます。初回ご利用時に審査があり、通常2営業日で結果をお知らせします。毎月末締めで翌月初めに請求書を発行しますので、翌月末までに銀行振込でお支払いください。請求書は適格請求書の要件を満たしており、登録番号が記載されています。与信枠は初回は月50万円までで、ご利用実績に応じて引き上げます。

title: お届け時間帯の指定
description: 日本国内の配送では、午前中、14時から16時、16時から18時、18時から20時、19時から21時の時間帯を指定できます。

Khi có sự kiện như đơn hàng mới hoặc thay đổi trạng thái giao hàng, Hikari gửi webhook dạng POST đến URL mà đối tác đã đăng ký.
